Class InlineTuiRunner

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.InlineTuiRunner
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class InlineTuiRunner extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Event loop for inline displays.

InlineTuiRunner combines the inline display semantics of InlineDisplay with the event handling capabilities of TuiRunner. It provides:

  • Raw mode for key event reading (like TuiRunner)
  • NO alternate screen (stays inline, like InlineDisplay)
  • Tick events for animations (WaveText, etc.)
  • Automatic redraw on terminal resize
  • Input reader thread for responsive keyboard handling
  • Thread-safe operations for background task integration
try (var runner = InlineTuiRunner.create(4)) {
    int[] progress = {0};

    runner.run(
        (event, r) -> {
            if (event instanceof TickEvent) {
                progress[0] = Math.min(100, progress[0] + 1);
                if (progress[0] >= 100) r.quit();
            }
            return true;
        },
        frame -> {
            gauge(progress[0] / 100.0).render(frame.area(), frame.buffer());
        }
    );
}

    • run

      public void run(InlineEventHandler handler, Renderer renderer) throws Exception
      Runs the main event loop with the given handler and renderer.

      The event handler is called for each event (key, mouse, tick). The renderer is called to update the display when the handler returns true.

      Parameters:
      handler - the event handler
      renderer - the UI renderer
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during execution

    • setContentHeight

      public void setContentHeight(int height)
      Sets the content height for the next draw.

      This controls how many terminal lines are allocated for the inline display. Calling this before rendering allows the display to grow or shrink dynamically.

      Parameters:
      height - the desired content height in lines

    • runOnRenderThread

      public void runOnRenderThread(Runnable action)
      Executes an action on the render thread.

      If called from the render thread, the action is executed immediately. If called from another thread, the action is queued for execution.

      Parameters:
      action - the action to execute

    • runLater

      public void runLater(Runnable action)
      Queues an action to be executed on the render thread.

      Unlike runOnRenderThread(Runnable), this method always queues the action even if called from the render thread.

      Parameters:
      action - the action to execute

    • scheduler

      public ScheduledExecutorService scheduler()
      Returns the shared scheduler for scheduling tasks.

      This scheduler runs on a dedicated daemon thread. Tasks scheduled here execute on the scheduler thread, not the render thread. To modify UI state from a scheduled task, use runOnRenderThread(Runnable).

      Returns:
      the scheduler (never null)

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes this runner and releases resources.

      If a scheduler was provided via configuration, it is NOT shut down - the caller retains ownership and is responsible for its lifecycle. If no scheduler was provided, the internally-created scheduler is shut down.

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
